description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mr. Bodhiya Baduge Niwlin Perera, Hedigama, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals without wills. It involves land parcels, cadastral maps, property registration under the Registration of Title Act, and the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement - all falling under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
